usageNotes: Use this to enumerate all nodes in a PVE remote managed by PDM, including their live status, CPU/memory utilization, and uptime. The remote must already be registered in PDM and the caller must hold Resource.Audit on the remote resource. Node-level metrics (cpu, mem, maxcpu, maxmem, uptime) are optional fields and may be absent if a node is offline or unreachable.

examples.summary: List all nodes for a registered PVE remote named 'pve-hetzner'

tips: Check the 'status' field on each returned node before acting on it — only 'online' nodes will have valid cpu/mem metrics.
The 'ssl_fingerprint' field can be used to verify node identity if you need to cross-check TLS trust.
Remote name must match the PDM-registered ID exactly (2–32 chars, alphanumeric/dot/dash/underscore, no leading dot or dash).
